evidence.observation: SporeApp.exe 3.1.0.22 at VA 0x00e52910 normalizes to cell_ai_select_profile_00e52910.
ObservedCellAiData has an i32 type field at +0x00 and a 0xb4 stride; ObservedCellCellResource stores normal, aiHard, and aiEasy profiles at +0xe0, +0x194, and +0x248.
The function reads the serializable offset from game + 0x5190 and the difficulty from serializable + 0x7c, selects easy for 0 and hard for 2, and selects normal for all other values.
Only selected easy or hard profiles with type -1 fall back to normal; the function performs no mutation and has no null check.
The target has 23 direct callers and 0 direct callees.

Live decompilation reads the serializable pointer from Simulator__Cell__sCellGame + 0x5190, reads difficulty at +0x7c, selects +0x248 for 0, +0x194 for 2, and +0xe0 otherwise, then falls back to +0xe0 when the selected profile type is -1.

Live disassembly has 21 instructions: MOV EAX,[0x016b3c04], MOV ECX,dword ptr [EAX+0x5190], MOV EAX,dword ptr [ECX+0x7c], difficulty branches to +0x248, +0x194, or +0xe0, followed by CMP dword ptr [EAX],-1 and the +0xe0 fallback; no write or CALL instruction appears.
